_howTo: Wine page. 'styles' and 'regions' are the areas you want to highlight. 'staffPicks' rotates automatically: every rotateEveryDays days the page shows the next wine from each group. Each wine has a name, style, short note and a photo (a file name in src/assets/photos/). Add wines to any group, or add a new group. startDate (YYYY-MM-DD) is the day the first wine in each group is shown. No prices.
